content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Online marketplace connecting hosts and guests; it does not own or operate hotel properties."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Casino gaming operator where gaming wagers drive revenue, not hotel room ownership and operation."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Live entertainment venue operator selling tickets and events, not hotel rooms and meeting space."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Casino resort operator whose core business is gaming, with hotels secondary to gambling."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"News, publishing and property listing portals; a media business unrelated to hotel operations."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Office building REIT leasing space to corporate tenants, not hotel rooms sold to travelers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Las Vegas casino resorts centered on gaming for local and visitor customers, not upscale hotel ownership."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Travel technology software and booking distribution sold to airlines and agencies, not a hotel owner."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Owns upscale and select-service hotels with third-party managers, selling rooms, F&B and meeting space to travelers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Restaurant operator and brand licensor selling dining, not owning hotel properties or selling guest rooms."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Theme park operator selling admission and attractions to families, not hotel rooms or meeting space."}]}
